A type of oven used to cook [[Bread/Legends|bread]], an '''old-style bread oven'''<ref name="Inside" /> consisted of a [[Color/Legends|cream]]-colored body with a rectangualr front face. In the top left corner of that face was a gray panel with an alcove below it in the bottom left. A series of red and green lights then ran up right side of the device's front face.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> When they hosted a group of offworlders during a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]]<ref name="Inside" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] had an old-style bread oven installed on the wall above their kitchen counter in their [[Skywalker home/Legends|home]] on [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|Slave Quarters Row]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
A thermic baster appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> The item was first identified in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]] and illustrated by [[Richard Chasemore]] and [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="Inside" />
